d:
Groove to the folk beats with "Saranga Dariya" from the movie "Love Story"! Featuring Naga Chaitanya and Sai Pallavi, this vibrant track is composed by Pawan Ch and sung energetically by Mangli. A perfect celebration of folk music and dance!
Discover this Song on Popular Streaming Platforms.
Song Credits:
Song Name : Saranga Dariya
Singer : Mangli
Backing vocals: Sinduri Vishal, Sushmita Narasimhan
Lyrics : Suddala Ashok Teja
Music: Pawan CH
